Restructuring interview question

A company goes bust. Who gets the money first?

One question. Most people get the last part wrong.

The question

Company sells for $500M. It owes $300M of senior loans and $250M of bonds. How much do bondholders get?

A$250M
B$200M
C$0
D$125M

Pick one, then swipe.

Answer
B. $200M
$300M
Senior loans firstpaid in full
$200M
Bonds get what's left$500M − $300M
$0
Shareholdersnothing left over

The order

Senior debt → bonds → equity last.

That's the capital stack. Each layer only gets paid after the one above it is made whole.

Curveball 🔥

Bondholders get $200M on a $250M claim. Recovery rate?

80%

$200M ÷ $250M. Bankers say they recovered 80 cents on the dollar.

Did you get both? 👇
